intent: A split button: a primary action segment plus a chevron that opens a menu of related choices. The chevron stays operable even when the action is disabled, so the menu is always reachable.
use_when: A default action with related alternatives behind a menu (crop aspect, export format).
Capability gating where the menu must stay reachable while the action is disabled.
dont_use_when: Many equal options — use a menu or SegmentedControl.

a11y.role: two native buttons — an action (aria-label + aria-pressed) and a menu chevron (aria-haspopup=menu + aria-expanded).
a11y.gating: the chevron remains operable when the action segment is disabled.

code.example:
<SplitButton icon={<Crop/>} actionLabel="Reset crop" menuLabel="Aspect ratio"
  onIconClick={reset} menuTrigger={t => <PopoverMenu trigger={t}>…</PopoverMenu>} />
